summary: PHP Ventures Acquisition Corp., a blank-check SPAC, filed an 8-K reporting two items: (1) the trustee of its trust account returned excess funds following stockholder approval of an amended extension plan that lowered the monthly contribution required to extend the deadline for an initial business combination from $4,770.70 to $957.30 per month, and (2) it deposited $957.30 to extend the deadline one more month to May 16, 2026. The 8-K provides no new business-combination transaction, terms, or advisor details. This is a routine extension update, not a special-situation event. Watch for a de-SPAC or liquidation risk if no deal is consummated by December 31, 2026.
